entry.author: Inland Revenue NZ
entry.summary:
Kia ora! Welcome to part 4 of 5 of our GST workshop. In part 4, we'll discuss when an adjustment is needed and how it is calculated. GST is a tax added to the price of most goods and services, including imports. Supplies are goods or services you provide while carrying on your business. For GST purposes, supplies are dealt with differently depending on the type of supply. 

----------------------------------------------------------------

More information:

Find out more about GST: https://www.ird.govt.nz/gst

You may need to adjust the GST claimed if the business, exempt or private use of a good or service changes. Find out more about adjustments, here: https://www.ird.govt.nz/gst/gst-adjustments/change-in-use-adjustments-for-gst

----------------------------------------------------------------

If you have enjoyed this video, watch our other parts:

GST Workshop part 1 (Registering): https://youtu.be/dQod_CI5Shc 
GST Workshop part 2 (Supplies): https://youtu.be/9vHVUNWoO04
GST Workshop part 3 (Record Keeping): https://youtu.be/jFabeqq2MdY
GST Workshop part 5 (Filing and Ceasing GST): https://youtu.be/51TZd4UIHK0 

----------------------------------------------------------------
